scope: Independent read-only review of frozen evaluator and run04 saved outputs/provenance, historical diagnosis, and independent NumPy reconstruction of metrics; no TF rerun and no hardware run by this reviewer.

reporting_conditions.detail: All 15 FP32 C top1 predictions agree with the current official TF model (15/15 agreement). True labels are correct for 14/15 overall, 13/14 real WAVs, 11/12 published testing examples, 2/2 validation examples and 1/1 synthetic zero. Never describe 15/15 agreement as 100% label accuracy.

INT16 outputs are isolated FFN1 operator results using official fresh LN1 input independently at each layer. The full classification path is C FP32 starting from the same official frontend/token tensor and using the same classifier head; it does not establish INT16 end-to-end classification accuracy.

Only 351/405 selected current tensors match pinned historical bits; all 54 differences belong to the two validation inputs. The old diagnosis JSON asserts a Grappler/fusion cause more strongly than its experiment establishes. Current diagnostic source now labels Grappler/fusion as possible, not isolated proof. The historical artifact is retained as old-version evidence; no complete historical root cause is established.

The saved restore proves 162 model variables numerically exact with their checkpoint tensors using np.array_equal(after, stored), which does not distinguish signed zero. Packed encoder weights and classifier-head arrays are checked by bits_sha256; all live model weights are compared as uint32 before/after inference. Use this precise wording instead of claiming a recorded all-162 uint32 checkpoint comparison.

The new 180-case cohort is 15 inputs x 12 layers; old 36-case cohort is 3 inputs x 12 layers. Their aggregate percentages must remain separate; a lower value on a different sample cohort is not evidence that quantization was tuned or improved.

verified_numeric_definition.formula: e_l = sqrt(sum_samples SSE_l / count_l) / max(sqrt(sum_samples sum(Y_ref^2)_l / count_l), 1e-8); e = max over 12 layers of e_l
verified_numeric_definition.threshold_scope: Only the frozen 15-input engineering cohort; no official contest acceptance

data_and_model_provenance.main_inference_dependency: Current full official graph regenerated from D-root WAVs plus explicit synthetic zero; no C-workspace cached tensor is loaded by the core recheck. Historical audit/diagnosis alone uses the old cache for comparison.
data_and_model_provenance.no_fitting_or_selection: Evaluator only infers and applies derive_layer_config to frozen parameters, then requires equality with each existing frozen configuration. No training/fine-tuning/search or test-set parameter selection occurs.
data_and_model_provenance.silence_interpretation: Synthetic zero has true/predicted _silence_. The published _silence_ example is nonzero background-noise audio (15997 nonzero PCM16 samples), and both FP32 implementations predict _unknown_; these are different inputs.

historical_comparison.independent_scope: The 351/405 bit relation is independently verified from actual fresh array bits against pinned manifest digests. Numeric historical deltas are read from the existing self-audit/diagnosis receipts; old tensor cache was not read by this NumPy audit.
historical_comparison.old_diagnosis_policy: Old source hashes are expected historical provenance, not evidence of a current-source diagnostic rerun.

pass_publication_logic.assessment: local_ffn1_pass is computed from finite worst-layer NRMSE before selecting and writing status; fail branch selects FAIL_LOCAL_FFN1_NRMSE and returns exit1. Complete run acceptance must additionally use process exit0 and artifact availability.

limits: This review does not execute TF or independently reload all 162 live model tensors; it checks saved restore evidence and source logic.
Only two real validation WAVs, both unknown-class, and twelve selected testing examples; no representative population/official600 estimate.
No end-to-end INT16 classification evidence, official12 performance tasks, organizer platform, STA/area/power/energy or formal score follows from this precision report.
Root run05 and package fresh hardware results require their own process/receipt validation; their completion is not asserted here.
